newsitem.title: USA: Buckeye dismisses Polymer offer for Merfin.
newsitem.headline: Buckeye dismisses Polymer offer for Merfin.

text.p: Buckeye Cellulose Corp said Friday that it stands by its all cash offer for Merfin International Inc, which is being targeted for acquisition by Polymer Group Inc.
Polymer said earlier Friday that it is offering Merfin shareholders a cash payment of C$7.15 per share, or an average undiscounted price of no less than C$7.60 and no more than C$8.68.

"The Polymer Group's "offer" to purchase all of the shares of Merfin is not an offer at all," Buckeye said in a statement, adding that Polymer's offer would be subject to the effectiveness of a registration statement with the Securities Exchange Commission that could take weeks or months.
Merfin's board has recommended that shareholders accept Buckeye's offer of C$7 a share.
